result.summary: Backports PR #35878 to the 31.x maintenance branch and prepares the branch for the v31.3 point release. It updates P2P transaction inventory handling to process unique transaction announcements only, avoiding spurious work on conflicting advertisements. It also bumps the project version and updates documentation and manual pages for v31.3.
result.problem: The 31.x maintenance branch performs redundant processing when receiving conflicting transaction inventory announcements that cannot both enter the mempool, and it lacks the version and documentation updates required for releasing v31.3.
evidence: Commit eeb3e249eb (backport of #35878): 'There is no reason we should process conflicting advertisements for transactions, as they cannot be both accepted into our mempool. Avoid processing these and doing spurious work.'
result.scope_notes: This is a maintenance backport PR targeted at 31.x, bundling a net_processing bugfix with standard release preparation commits (version bump, man pages, and release notes).
result.card: Prepares the 31.x maintenance branch for the v31.3 release and backports PR #35878 to process unique transaction INVs only. Without this backport, 31.x nodes perform unnecessary work processing conflicting transaction advertisements that cannot both be accepted into the mempool. It includes version bumps, release notes, and man page updates for v31.3.

risk.why: A flaw in backporting net_processing inventory handling could disrupt transaction relay or INV processing on nodes running the 31.x maintenance release.
